mentions.name: FPV Mania
mentions.description: A free to play FPV drone racing game that runs in the web browser on integrated graphics, featuring a global leaderboard. Emphasis on realistic flight physics including aerodynamics, PIDs and filtering, propwash, and signal noise.
mentions.source_excerpt: Free to play FPV racing game with a global leaderboard that can run on integrated grapics in the web browser. Focus is on realistic physics (aero, PIDs and filtering, propwash, signal noise).
